claims.evidence: Photo 0 cover shows title 'The Sixth and Seventh Books of Moses'

risks.risk: Condition of pages (tears, stains, writing, missing pages)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the title page, several random pages, and page edges
Photos of the spine, front and rear hinges, and binding from multiple angles
Photo of the copyright/title page showing publisher and year

risks.risk: Whether a dust jacket is included
risks.proof: Photo showing the dust jacket or its absence
Video of pages being fanned or close-up of page edges for smoke staining, plus seller confirmation

proof_requests: Close-up photos of pages and page edges
Photo of copyright/title page for edition and year
Photo showing dust jacket or its absence
Video or statement confirming no smoke or odor damage
response.reason: The witness identifies the book by title and editor, so the item can be priced at its worst case; the seller's title claim is supported by the cover photo.
